title: Greater Cambridge Shared Planning: AI-Driven Summarisation for Local Plan Consultations
summary: Greater Cambridge reports that a consultation-summary task fell from 18.5 officer hours to 16 AI minutes while officers still read every response.
account: Greater Cambridge Shared Planning reports that an LLM summarizes consultation comments while planning officers still read every submission. The tool was used in three supplementary-planning-document consultations in winter 2024–25. A summary task reportedly fell from 18.5 officer hours to 16 AI minutes. The reported saving of over 60% does not directly reconcile with those times.
purpose: Summarize planning-consultation representations and identify themes while retaining officer review.
system: Bespoke planning-consultation LLM with the Opus Consult platform
developer: University of Liverpool (LLM); JDi Solutions (Opus Consult platform)

ratings.reason: The completed summary task and soft launch in three consultations support time savings.
Less summary-writing work frees officers for analysis and engagement. This is a task-time benefit.
Improved public participation is intended. Its extent is unknown.

ai_role.statement: The source attributes draft summaries and thematic analysis to the bespoke LLM. The reported time comparison concerns summarization, while officers continue to read every representation. The source does not establish improved consultation decisions.

evidence.citation: Council or project account published in the Local Government Association AI case-study bank. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Greater Cambridge Shared Planning: AI-Driven Summarisation for Local Plan Consultations

produced_by: The model was developed with 15 years of consultation material, including over 55,000 representations and planning-specific terminology.
It was soft-launched in three supplementary-planning-document consultations in winter 2024–25.
must_hold: The reported workflow retains officer reading of every representation.
The source does not establish which data or model conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported saving.

headline: Greater Cambridge reports faster consultation summaries
claim_basis: Sources: the deployer's report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
